svg.title: Praxi architecture
svg.desc: The Praxi daemon (Rust, tokio, axum) listens on 127.0.0.1 only. The desktop app and CLI call its local API. The daemon runs the agent loop, checks every tool call in the permission engine and approval gate, and keeps secrets in the OS keychain. It dials out to LLM providers (cloud, or local Ollama and LM Studio), MCP servers, connectors and Telegram. Node-agents on other machines dial out to the daemon, so no inbound ports are needed.

g.text: Checked in code on every tool call.
Reads are free, changes ask, money
ARROWS POINT FROM THE SIDE THAT OPENS THE CONNECTION
